title_zh: 2026全球数字经济大会拉萨分会场活动举行
title_en: 2026 Global Digital Economy Conference Lhasa Sub-forum Held
summary_zh: 8月18日，2026全球数字经济大会拉萨分会场活动举行，西藏自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁出席并致辞。
summary_en: On August 18, the Lhasa sub-forum of the 2026 Global Digital Economy Conference was held, with Dawa Tsering, member of the Standing Committee of the Tibet Autonomous Regional Party Committee and Party Secretary of Lhasa, attending and delivering a speech.
